source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
Errata rewriting the target and effect of [Berzerker’s Wrath](vsdata:ability/world-eaters.berzerker-warband.berzerkers-wrath), which is used in your opponent's Shooting phase, right after an enemy unit has shot:

- Target: 1 friendly **KHORNE BERZERKERS** unit that those enemy attacks let make a **[surge move](vsdata:core-rule/surge-move)**.
- Effect: that unit's models move up to 8″ on that surge move, with no D6 rolled for the distance.
